youtube.title: Using AI to research and score a prospect list
youtube.description:
James and Hannah cover how to hand AI an ideal customer profile and a list of companies. It researches each one and returns a table with a fit score, the evidence behind it and anything it couldn't check. A person then reads the top of the list and the borderline cases.

clips.linkedin:
Hand AI your ideal customer profile and a company list and get back a scored, sourced research table.

In the latest Manual Focus we cover how a small team can research every account on a list, which used to be too slow to do for every account. It means you can send to fewer, better-chosen people.

Give the AI your ideal customer profile and a list of companies. It researches each one and returns a fit score with the evidence and a link, the trigger if there is one, the legal form and anything it couldn't check. A person then reads the top and the borderline cases.

The podcast voices are AI-generated, and mine is a clone of my own voice.

Full episode and article at https://manual-focus.co.uk/blog/go-to-market-automation-claude-apollo-basics/
clips.text: Get AI on this. Three jobs. First, get AI on the research and scoring. Give it your ideal customer profile and a list of companies, either an export from your prospecting database or a connected one. It researches each account against the profile and hands back a table with a fit score, the evidence and a link for each score, the trigger if there is one, the account's legal form, and anything it couldn't check. Then a person reads the top and the borderline cases.
